_comment: Game modes. Every flag here must appear in ContentValidator.HONOURED_MODE_FLAGS and be read by real code; a flag the game does not read is a promise the game does not keep. Combat-triangle advantage/disadvantage values are [assumption]: the brief fixes the direction but gives no numbers, so they are data-driven and tunable here.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: no caps, no extra limits — the intended first experience

hardcore.name: Hardcore
hardcore.description: a 108-stack storage cap and a 20% combat-triangle penalty

adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.description: non-combat skills cap at your combat level, and combat hits 10x harder

ancient_relics.name: Ancient Relics
ancient_relics.description: every skill caps at 10 and a 20% combat-triangle penalty applies
